evidence.observation: Pressure was 649.579 mbar, consistent with the preceding approximately 648–650 mbar baseline.
Pressure abruptly fell to 633.355 mbar, reflux flow fell from 0.150 to 0.005 L/h, and PDI701 rose to 1.182 mbar.
Pressure remains below baseline at 636.729 mbar; reflux partially recovered to 0.124 L/h, distillate flow is only 0.010 L/h, and PDI701 increased further to 1.241 mbar.
T701 reports 385.833 °C versus T702 at 114.794 °C; the persistent large temperature discrepancy warrants independent verification but does not identify a sensor fault.
